Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

FineWeb as described in 2406.17557v2 · derived from: The paper-described FineWeb release is produced from 96 Common Crawl snapshots and contains about 15 trillion GPT-2-tokenized tokens.

candidate.paperfull.fineweb.crawl-release-lineage

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • This is the release described by the pinned 2024 paper, not a current mutable Hub snapshot. Common Crawl sourcing does not establish a commercial supplier contract.
  • The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at ScaleLocator: PDF p. 7; 3.7 The final FineWeb dataset, first paragraph

    96 Common Crawl snapshots

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

FineWeb as described in 2406.17557v2 · paper method: The FineWeb datasheet states that the released dataset still includes significant numbers of documents that may be toxic or harmful.

candidate.paperfull.fineweb.harmful-content-remains

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • URL filtering and limited regex treatment of email/public IP addresses do not guarantee safety, absence of bias or full de-identification. This is a scoped author-reported limitation.
  • The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at ScaleLocator: PDF p. 19; A FineWeb Datasheet / Biases

    toxic or contain harmful content

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

FineWeb as described in 2406.17557v2 · filtered: The final FineWeb pipeline uses individual per-crawl MinHash deduplication.

candidate.paperfull.fineweb.per-crawl-deduplication

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Section 3.4 (p.5) compares this with global MinHash. The paper’s empirical choice is scoped to its data/training/evaluation setup and does not prove global deduplication is universally worse.
  • The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at ScaleLocator: PDF p. 7; 3.7 The final FineWeb dataset, first paragraph

    individual per-crawl MinHash
